in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Prosperity

This name is associated with the goddess Lakshmi, who is the embodiment of prosperity and wealth in Hindu mythology. It is believed that invoking the blessings of Shaambhavya can bring prosperity, success, and good fortune in all aspects of life.
